$comment: Catalog of known KID entities. Validation does not depend on this file (the catalog is open); implementations use it for typed accessors, value constraints of the short entities and the frozen canonical head order. Adding an entity is a pull request here. One object kind has exactly one entity name; aliases are forbidden.

b.name: branch
b.note: default is dropped by canonicalization; dev and * are pattern-only

bucket.name: bucket
bucket.note: bucket id such as in.c-main; c- prefix not guaranteed

table.name: table
table.note: table name only; the bucket carries the rest of today's table id

component.name: component
component.note: component id such as keboola.ex-db-snowflake; classification, not ownership

app.name: data app
app.note: a data app is a configuration
